name: Jui Li Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Jui Li Enterprise Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in production and sales of automobile parts, and wholesale of sports equipment in Taiwan and China. The company operates through Automotive Business Group; Sports Equipment Business Group; and Others segment. It offers exterior body parts, including hood and lid assemblies, front and rear door SASH, front and rear door assemblies LH, front and rear door assemblies RH, fender LH and RH, body-side LH and RH, roofs with sunroof, and roofs, as well as aluminum ally tail-gate assemblies. The company also provides rails and under-body parts; and chassis and structure parts, such as front and rear sub frames. In addition, it offers aftermarket products, including hoods, fenders, radiator supports, rebars, bumper and plastic brackets, and grilles, as well as motorcycle and automobile stamping parts, stamping dies, and jigs. Further, the company provides leasing of real estate investments; sporting goods and accessories; car models; automotive parts; and electronic parts and their molds, fixtures, and gauges, as well as maintenance services. Jui Li Enterprise Co., Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
